class.name: fly_brain/HaltereReflexController
class.description: M2 haltere-analog reflex controller: fly_brain::ComplementaryFilter -> fly_brain::HaltereReflex (outer P attitude loop -> inner PD rate loop against raw gyro) -> QuadMixer thrust allocation. Claims thrust1..4/effort command interfaces and the imu/* state interfaces. Chainable: exports "roll"/"pitch"/"yaw_rate"/"thrust" reference interfaces for a future DescendingFusionController (M4) to write; standalone (not chained) mode sources a fixed level-attitude-hold setpoint from its own parameters. M3 optionally adds ONE extra claimed command interface (parameter- controlled, off by default) sourced from OpticFlowController's exported reference interfaces, additively modulating the effective yaw-rate setpoint as a standalone preview of M4's optomotor fusion term. Note: controller_manager loads chainable controllers via a separate pluginlib ClassLoader templated on controller_interface::ChainableControllerInterface from plain controller_interface::ControllerInterface ones (see NOTES.md's "## M2" section) - base_class_type here must be "controller_interface::ChainableControllerInterface", NOT "controller_interface::ControllerInterface" as fly_controller_plugins.xml uses for the (non-chainable) M1 BaselinePidController.

class.name: fly_brain/OpticFlowController
class.description: M3 optic-flow-analog visual reflex controller: downsamples /drone/camera/image_raw to a coarse grayscale grid and feeds fly_brain::ReichardtEmdArray (Hassenstein-Reichardt elementary-motion- detector array with antisymmetric/symmetric LPTC-style spatial pooling). Claims no hardware command or state interfaces at all (pure perception, topic-driven only). Chainable: exports yaw_rate/roll_drift/forward_drift/vertical_drift reference interfaces, matching fly_brain::OpticFlowEstimate's fields, for HaltereReflexController (this milestone) and a future DescendingFusionController (M4) to consume. See NOTES.md's "## M3" section for a real naming gotcha: despite the field name, "yaw_rate" is not the field that tracks camera yaw rotation - "forward_drift" is (confirmed by an analytic ground-truth bench comparing pooled output against known egomotion).

class.name: fly_brain/DescendingFusionController
class.description: M4 descending-fusion controller: the top of the fly-brain chain. Claims HaltereReflexController's exported roll/pitch/yaw_rate/thrust reference interfaces as its own command interfaces, and optionally OpticFlowController's chosen reference interface the same way (superseding HaltereReflexController's own M3 optic-flow bolt-on). Runs a real closed-loop altitude PID against /drone/free_joint_states (topic, not a hardware interface), composes a fixed parameter-sourced task command, and calls fly_brain::DescendingFusion::fuse() to produce the fused attitude/thrust setpoint written into HaltereReflexController's claimed interfaces every cycle. Exports no reference interfaces of its own (it is the top of the chain, not a middle layer). Same base-class-type caveat as the other two fly_brain controllers above: controller_manager loads chainable controllers via a separate pluginlib ClassLoader from plain ControllerInterface ones, so base_class_type here must be controller_interface::ChainableControllerInterface.

class.name: fly_brain/PhototaxisController
class.description: M5 phototaxis-analog visual-target-seeking controller: runs fly_brain::ColorBlobDetector (a per-pixel color threshold + centroid, a DIFFERENT algorithm from OpticFlowController's motion-based Reichardt EMD array) on /drone/camera/image_raw to find a bright, saturated attractant target by its static color/appearance rather than its motion. Claims no hardware command or state interfaces at all (pure perception, topic-driven only, same shape as OpticFlowController). Chainable: exports target_visible/bearing/area_fraction reference interfaces for DescendingFusionController to consume and turn into a turn-toward/approach task command. Same base-class-type caveat as the other fly_brain controllers: controller_manager loads chainable controllers via a separate pluginlib ClassLoader from plain ControllerInterface ones, so base_class_type here must be controller_interface::ChainableControllerInterface.
